description: On the table in front are a small green basket, a gray plastic bin, a couple of round lids, a yellow die, and a pink cookie-like piece. The right hand reaches forward and down into the green basket to grasp a small white round lid (right-hand object), lifts it up and carries it rightward, then lowers it into the gray bin and releases it, while the left hand stays open and mostly still near the front edge.
